title: Fan Favorite Revealed in Official Mummy Franchise Poll
text:
The officialmovies has revealed the results of their poll to determine the best iteration of the Mummy franchise, with the 1999 film starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz emerging as the clear fan favorite.
The officialmovies has revealed the fan favorite in their poll to determine the best iteration of the franchise. The clear winner is the 1999 film starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz, which currently holds over 79% of the vote.
The film's sequel, released in 2001, is a distant second with just over 4% of the vote. The decision to bring back Fraser and Weisz for a fourth film in the franchise was likely influenced by the fan reaction to the 1999 film. The return of Oded Fehr and Kevin J. O'Connor to their roles in the new film, as well as the confirmation of Arnold Vosloo's return, is also generating fan anticipation.
The new film is set to be released in 2027 and is expected to capitalize on the fan interest in the franchise. The film's divisive release earlier this year and lack of box office success may not be indicative of its long-term prospects, and it is possible that the poll results may change over time as more people discover the film
